title: Spot the Plant
summary: Rogue has V sit on a Charter Hill terrace and name the one passer-by who is carrying something they should not.
description: Rogue has V sit on a Charter Hill cafe terrace with coffee and watch the people walk past. One of them is carrying something they should not.

start.bringUp: You want V on a Charter Hill terrace to sit and watch people walk past. Bring up, briefly and in your own way, that you have an afternoon free and want company.

variations.know: It is raining. Umbrellas hide hands, and the terrace is wet.
It is evening, and a wedding crowd crosses the terrace.
Two plants walk the terrace. Rogue wants both found, and V names the one carrying the concealed item.

terrace-rain.name: the Charter Hill cafe terrace in the rain

terrace-evening.name: the Charter Hill cafe terrace at dusk

terrace-two.name: the Charter Hill cafe terrace with two plants

g1.asks: What gave it away so far? Don't guess, tell me what you saw.
g1.know: Five passers-by walk the terrace path. One carries a concealed item under a coat. Two others are decoys, a courier with a briefcase and a man who keeps checking his watch. Rogue gives hints only if V asks.

stages.label: Rogue has V name the plant on the terrace
stages.objective: Name the passer-by hiding something on the terrace with Rogue
stages.know: You and V sit on the Charter Hill terrace with coffee. Five passers-by walk the path. One carries a concealed item, and two are decoys. You give hints only if V asks.
stages.wants: V to name the one carrying the concealed item, and to say why.

do.who: passer-by in a grey coat, walking the path
courier with a briefcase, a decoy
man with a gun holster under his coat, the one carrying the item
man who keeps checking his watch, a decoy
woman with a shopping bag, passing

choices.means: V names one of the decoys, the courier with the briefcase or the man checking his watch
V names the man with the holster under his coat
V names none of them, or says any of them could be it

right.memory: You named the passer-by with the holster under his coat, and Rogue told you what she had been watching for.

wrong.memory: You named the wrong passer-by but said why, and Rogue said that was a fair try.

unsure.memory: You sat on the terrace and watched, and named nobody.

stood-up.memory: V did not come to the Charter Hill terrace, and Rogue drank her coffee alone.
